google.reason: October 6 Nano Banana 2.1 GA verified. Select documented panoramic-image evaluation around the reported 2K/4K tiling fix; wide ratios already existed and are not called new.

architectures.reason: October 2 retrieval-centric nonparametric network paper abstract and date reviewed. Promising mechanism lead needs full paper/artifact review; not approved from abstract alone.

editorial_review.viewer_question: What should an image-API developer check when evaluating Nano Banana 2.1 for panoramic banners?
editorial_review.prerequisites: Gemini API key, a client able to call the Interactions endpoint and inspect returned images; no consumer-app rollout assumed.
editorial_review.central_task: Evaluate a wide 2K banner using the new model ID and inspect visual seams and text.
editorial_review.new_capability: October 6 GA model update with a documented panoramic tiling fix; the aspect ratios themselves are not new.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: Gemini Live Avatar and Connected Apps are unrelated; no image-model evaluation in archive.
editorial_review.archive_check: Ten episode JSON files, publication metadata and eight public receipts reviewed. No Nano Banana image-generation episode. September 27 Gemini Live Avatar and September 28 Connected Apps concern different capabilities. No queued October 7 episode.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Know the model ID, supported resolution and response_format controls before a controlled visual comparison.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented source walkthrough; no generated image or reproduced quality benchmark.
editorial_review.alternatives: Decisions API beta is equally timely but needs a separate typed-output task. Cyber access program serves security teams. Paper requires deeper verification. No generic router listing is treated as release evidence.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: Fresh leading-provider image-model update with a specific documented fix and actionable evaluation path.
editorial_review.search_query: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 panoramic image API
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved: new October 6 model update absent from ten archived episodes; opening delivers a concrete image-evaluation task and first request settings. Existing wide ratios are not mislabeled new. Google quality claims and our unexecuted evaluation plan are distinguished.
editorial_review.metadata_review: Full upload.build_description inspected: exact model and task first, primary model page plus guide and dated release links, one models playlist, episode marker/downloads/music present; no invented chapters or benchmark.

playlist_review.reason: The entire video covers one newly released image model for API developers: exact ID, reported panoramic fix, request controls, access and output inspection. Sole models playlist; not an agent workflow or unrelated roundup.
